name: WattTime
tagline: Marginal emissions and grid signals for carbon-aware computing
description: WattTime provides real-time and forecasted marginal emissions data for electricity grids, enabling carbon-aware load shifting, scheduling, and reporting. Developers access region signals, historical emissions, and forecasts via a REST API used for research and production carbon optimization.

auth.details: Username/password registration; Bearer token obtained via login endpoint (JWT-style). Exact header and free-tier details need verification from current docs.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Basic (free) includes all signals and endpoints for CAISO_NORTH, plus the CO2 percentile signal for all covered regions.

rate_limits: 3,000 requests per rolling 5-minute window per user (10 requests/second average); /login is limited to 100 requests per 5 minutes.
use_cases: get current marginal emissions for a grid region
forecast cleanest hours to schedule flexible compute jobs
compare historical carbon intensity across balancing authorities
shift EV charging or HVAC load to lower-emissions periods
